english.title: Kill bovine animal in accordance with religious rites when not stunned and not restrained in upright pen
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[killed,]_
(B)_[caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to kill]_
(C)_[permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to kill]_

a bovine animal in accordance with religious rites without prior stunning when the animal was not individually restrained in an upright position in a restraining pen which had been approved in writing by the competent authority and which the competent authority was satisfied had been installed in such a manner as to ensure that it would operate efficiently
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(e) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 3(1) of Schedule 3 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
